2024|website=Kennebec Journal and Morning Sentinel}} is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]]. He attended [[Nokomis Regional High School]] in [[Newport, Maine]] as a freshman before transferring to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]]. Flagg won multiple [[List of U.S. high school basketball national player of the year awards|national high school player of the year]] honors as a senior and was ranked the top [[college recruiting|recruit]] in the 2024 class. He was named a consensus first-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] and the [[List of U.S. men's college basketball national player of the year awards|consensus national player of the year]]. ==Early life and high school career== Flagg was born in [[Newport, Maine]],{{cite web |last1=Manoj |first1=Kenneth |title=Cooper Flagg returns to Hoophall: Learn more about the Maine-born
